_doc: Dowser's Divining Coil (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2): his ability, held up out of slot 2 (Z): a flat search coil on a short handle. While it's up he can't shoot or use another gadget and walks at his own speed, and it shows him alone the other side's electronic devices (gadgets/coil.ts coilMarks: their devices marked `electronic`, the level's cameras, drones, Twain's idle frame) within `coil.rangeM` of his eye through anything, within `coil.fanDeg` of his facing across the floor, as outlines. A ping while it's up marks the one nearest his crosshair within `coil.pingDeg` for his team. An EMP on him empties it until it wears off. Never used up (its `count` is unused). Our own design and numbers.
name: Divining Coil
